01 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE WORK

An educator at heart.
A researcher by purpose.

I am a Senior Lecturer in the Department of Accounting & Finance at Universiti Tenaga Nasional (UNITEN), with an academic career spanning economics, energy research, academic development and postgraduate leadership.

My work brings together analytical inquiry and practical application. From energy market studies and industry consultancy to economics teaching and blended-learning design, I value research that informs decisions and education that prepares learners to contribute meaningfully.

I have also contributed to postgraduate programme coordination, academic governance, curriculum innovation and university-community engagement.
